navaid.name: Site Of Blubber Creek
navaid.description: Blubber Creek was the site where whaling ships once moored to process the cargo of whale meat. For six months of the year South Lynn experienced a pall of blubber being rendered down.

navaid.name: Welney Gate Sluice
navaid.description: Gate shut when river is high or river mouth is tide locked and/or Welches Dam Pumping station is operating.
